title: BJBJ GJBIBJCA GBJBI
about: The stories from my first State Fair with State Arts-In: fourteen days where the work itself faded into the background and the people, traditions, ridiculous stories, and little moments became the things I still remember.
body: BJBJ GJBIBJCA GBJBI picks up where my first Prep Week ended. The stage was built and the preparation was over, but State Arts-In wasn't. What followed was fourteen days at the Minnesota State Fair and my first time experiencing what it was actually like to live through the fair as an Artsie.

I don't remember many of the individual Tech Crew jobs from those two weeks, and apparently most of them weren't interesting enough to become songs. What I do remember are the moments around them: Mama Jasinta leading us through the hidden paths of the fair, learning the shortcuts and spaces that most fairgoers never knew existed, and slowly becoming comfortable in a place that had been completely unfamiliar only weeks earlier.

Then there are the stories that were simply fun enough to survive: pull-string fireworks in the dorms, inside jokes, traditions, friendships, and the strange little adventures that happened when a group of Artsies spent two weeks living and working together at the fair. Those moments did more to define my first fair than any list of Tech Crew assignments ever could.

By the end of those fourteen days, the new kid who had arrived for Prep Week wasn't quite as new anymore. State Arts-In had become more than a production I was helping with. I had learned its hidden places, picked up its traditions, collected stories of my own, and found a group of people I could call my State Arts-In family. This album is the collection of moments that made that first fair mine.
